title: Men's 200m World Rankings: October 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' men's 200m event ranking as of 27 October 2026. Scores are ranking points, not fastest race times. The official event list includes short-track 200m performances for some athletes; this is a dated top-ten snapshot, not the complete athlete population.

source.name: World Athletics — Men’s 200m World Rankings
source.note: Verified by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-11-01 against the linked official table: all ten names, countries, places and scores and the 27 October 2026 reference date were compared directly. IOC codes were mapped to ISO-2 countries (USA/US, BOT/BW, RSA/ZA, JAM/JM, CAN/CA, ZIM/ZW, GBR/GB, DOM/DO). Ranking points are not race times. The source includes short-track 200m performances for Lyles and Ogando. Top ten only; the live source may change.
